Field Label: Device(s)/Codes reflecting the design and intended purpose of the device
Field Description / Notes:
Device type codes reflecting the design type and intended purpose of the device.
Device type codes are provided in Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/2185. The device type codes applicable in this field are those found in Annex I, section I for a MDR product conformity assessment procedure and in Annex II, section I for a IVDR product conformity assessment procedure.

Device type codes reflecting specific device characteristics and/or device technology and/or specific knowledge for product verification. 
Device type codes are provided in Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/2185. The device type codes applicable in this field are those found in Annex I, section II for a MDR product conformity assessment procedure and in Annex II, section II for a IVDR product conformity assessment procedure.

The intended purpose in relation to which the device is assessed in the product conformity assessment procedure. Each intended purpose is provided in the certificate languages identified by the NB (when it uploads the certificate documents - see field certificateDocument).
Refer also to fields of entity LanguageSpecificContent in sheet 'Common'.

The Basic UDI-DI of a device in the scope of a quality conformity assessment procedure.
 
Notes:
Only one of the following must be given for adding a device in the scope of a quality conformity assessment procedure:
- Basic UDI-DI and issuing entity;
- Name;
- Reference/Catalogue number.
When registering a certificate, the Basic UDI-DI must already exist (registered) in Eudamed.
When registering an application (refused certificate or an application for conformity assessment) it is not mandatory to have registered the Basic UDI-DI in Eudamed.
